title: My AI Dungeon Master narrates a simulated game world. Here’s the playable RPG around it.
author: tschilpi
selftext:
I've spent three years building Lore & Legends Maker, a solo fantasy RPG with a virtual Dungeon Master.



I'm combining the improvisation of an AI DM with the visual setting and tactical party combat of a classic CRPG: authored locations, companions, spells, equipment and animated painterly backgrounds.



The engine maintains the world state and resolves game mechanics. AI interprets what the player attempts and narrates the resulting events. The design starts with a world for the DM to inhabit.



I use Claude Code and Codex in development. A recurring challenge is keeping the narrated outcome aligned with inventory, quest and combat changes. Testing an improvised action means checking both the response and what the game actually changed.



It's still an alpha. If you already play AI RPGs, I'd love you to test an unexpected approach and tell me whether the result holds together.



Play: [https://www.llmsaga.com/](https://www.llmsaga.com/)
